name: stratum
description: Run API + SPA together with auto-reload (dev)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --reload-delay 0.75 --reload-dir app --reload-dir ingestion --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.dev:web: wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/ping -t 180000 && npm run dev --prefix frontend
